candidates.title: Player One & The Mad Catz: An Interactive Video Game Jazz Experience
candidates.description:
Come out and join us for an interactive listening experience to hear Player One & The Mad Catz and to play retro games. Free entry for all. Retro games provided for you to play. Enjoy a beer while listening to the soothing jazz sounds from all your favorite games.
Player 1 and the Mad Catz are Philly’s only video game jazz fusion quintet, playing the best of retro and modern gaming soundtracks.

candidates.venue: Iffy Books, 404 S. 20th St., Philadelphia, 19146, United States
candidates.description:
In this workshop you’ll build a device that displays your GPS coordinates and the current time, without connecting to the internet or transmitting anything. 100% passive and off-grid, no internet or cell connection needed! 
We’ll use the MicroPython programming language and the Thonny IDE, following the instructions on this page. 
You’ll need to purchase a kit to complete this project, which includes the following parts: 

RP2040 Pi Pico microcontroller unit w/ pre-soldered header pins
830 tie point solderless breadboard
NEO-6 GPS unit w/ antenna

Survive the summer.

candidates.title: Red Rabbits De-Escalation training
candidates.venue: Wooden Shoe Books, 704 South St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
candidates.description: Join the Red Rabbis for their De-Escalation 101 training to learn some basics surrounding de-escalation practices that can be used towards greater community care int he streets or on the ground.  We will discuss ways to keep ourselves grounded, and practice co-regulation through tension and conflicts.  Great for organizers interested in practicing community safety/care in addition to public workers.  Every second Thursday of the month at the Shoe.  Masks required and provided!
